presenter.name: Prateek Dangwal
presenter.company: iTelematics® Software Private Limited, Bangalore, India

event.title: Battery Pack Simulator
event.subtitle: Simulate mission-critical battery packs with static and dynamic attributes for aerospace and EV applications.
event.description: Developers and engineers need realistic battery pack data during the development phase but have no access to real hardware. The simulator bridges this gap by generating configurable, realistic battery pack profiles.
